addedDraftHint: It is a draft: read it over, then set its status to “Published”.
addedFilled: “{title}” is added: the title comes from YouTube.
addedNoThumb: The thumbnail could not be kept: the “Fill in” button will pick it up later.
addedTyped: “{title}” is added with the title you typed.
albumAbsent: You can link a photo album to a video by installing a gallery module.
albumDown: The gallery module is not answering right now: the list of albums is unavailable.
bannerMissing: Titles to fill in: {titles}. Thumbnails to keep: {thumbs}. The site fetches them from YouTube, a few at a time.
bulkCatHelp: All the added videos go into this category.
bulkExpired: The preview has expired. Paste your addresses again.
bulkFull: {n} refused: the limit of {max} videos is reached.
bulkIntro: Paste up to {max} YouTube addresses, one per line. You will see a preview before anything is added.
bulkLeft: {n} videos are left to fill in (title or thumbnail): click “Fill in”. Videos without a title stay drafts.
bulkLeftDown: YouTube is not answering: {n} videos are left to fill in (title or thumbnail). Try again later with “Fill in”.
bulkNothing: No usable address. Start again with other addresses.
bulkRoom: There is room for {room} more videos (limit: {max}): the first ones will be added.
bulkStateHelp: Draft is a good idea: read over before publishing. A video without a title stays a draft.
bulkSummary: {good} address(es) ready out of {total}. The others will be ignored. Example of a valid address: {example}
catRemoved: Category deleted. Its videos no longer have a category.
catsIntro: Categories are used as a filter on the page. Change their order with the ↑ and ↓ buttons.
catsNone: No category yet. You can create some below, or do without.
completeAll: Done: {titles} titles and {thumbs} thumbnails filled in.
completeDown: YouTube is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes, or type the titles yourself.
completeSome: {titles} titles and {thumbs} thumbnails filled in. {left} videos left to fill in: click again.
confirmCatDelete: Delete this category? The videos stay, without a category.
confirmDelete: Delete this video? It leaves the library and the series (nothing is deleted at YouTube).
confirmHide: Hide this video? It will no longer be visible on the site.
confirmSeriesDelete: Delete this series? The videos stay in the library.
deleteHint: Removes the video from the library.
editNoEmbed: {service} does not allow this video to be played on other sites (or it is private). The site will only offer the “Watch on {service}” button.
editNoThumb: The thumbnail is not kept by the site yet: click “Refresh from YouTube” below, or choose your own image.
editNoTitle: This video has no title yet: type it below, or click “Refresh from YouTube”.
emptyText: Come back soon: the first ones are on their way.
errBulkEmpty: Paste at least one address. Example: {example}
errBulkLong: Text too long: {max} addresses at most at a time.
errBulkMany: You pasted {n} addresses: {max} at most at a time.
errCatFull: You have reached the limit of {max} categories.
errCover: Choose an image with the upload button: an address from elsewhere is not accepted.
errDate: Write the date like this: 2026-10-24 (year, month, day).
errDuration: Write the length like this: 12:34 or 1:02:03.
errPublishTitle: Write a title before publishing. Example: Lighting workshop, episode 1
errPublishTitleRow: This video has no title: open it and write one before publishing.
errSave: Saving did not work. Try again.
errSeriesDup: This video is already in the series.
errSeriesFull: You have reached the limit of {max} series.
errSeriesItemsFull: A series holds {max} videos at most.
err_channel: This is a channel address. Paste the address of a single video. Example: {example}
err_duplicate: This video is already in your library (“{title}”).
err_format: This address does not look like a YouTube video. Example: {example}
err_full: Your library is full: {max} videos at most.
err_host: Only YouTube videos are accepted for now. Example: {example}
err_id: The video's identifier is missing from this address. Example: {example}
err_missing: YouTube cannot find this video. Is it private or deleted? Check the address.
err_needTitle: YouTube is not answering right now. Type the title yourself (you can change it later). Example: Lighting workshop, episode 1
err_needTitlePrivate: YouTube could not read this video (private, or playing it elsewhere is forbidden). Type the title yourself. Example: Lighting workshop, episode 1
err_playlist: This is a playlist address. Paste the address of a single video. Example: {example}
fieldAlbumHelp: For example the photos of the event: a “See the photos” link appears under the video.
fieldCoverHelp: Upload an image if you do not want YouTube's.
fieldDateHelp: It is used for sorting: newest first. Example: 2026-10-24
fieldDescHelp: Plain text; https:// addresses become links. {max} characters at most.
fieldDurationHelp: Example: 12:34 or 1:02:03. Leave it empty if you do not know it.
fieldFreeHelp: Adds a small label (the word “Free” can be changed in the settings). Handy for a course or a free sample.
fieldSeriesDescHelp: A few words under the series title. {max} characters at most.
fieldSeriesStateHelp: Draft: the series is not visible. Published: it appears on the page.
fieldStateAddHelp: Draft: only the team sees it. You can publish it right after.
fieldStateHelp: Draft: only the team sees it. Published: visible to everyone. Hidden: taken off the site without being deleted.
fieldTitleOptionalHelp: Leave it empty: the title fills in by itself. Type it only if YouTube does not answer.
fieldTranscriptHelp: The words spoken in the video, shown in a collapsible block under the video. {max} characters at most.
fieldUrlHelp: Paste it as it is: the useless parts are dropped. Example: {example}
linkSee: See the page on the site
noEmbedNote: {service} does not allow playing this video here. Use the button below.
noPage: This video library has no public address yet: choose one in the “General” tab.
noResultText: Try other words, or go back to the full list.
noRight: You are not allowed to edit the videos.
playNote: The {service} player only loads after you click: nothing is sent before.
refreshedMissing: YouTube can no longer find this video: is it private or deleted?
refreshedPrivate: YouTube does not allow this video to be played elsewhere: only the “Watch on YouTube” button will be offered.
searchHelp: A word from the title or description.
seriesAdded: Series created: now add videos to it.
seriesEnd: That is the end of the list.
seriesFindHelp: A word from the title. Leave empty to see the newest.
seriesFindTitle: Add a video to the series
seriesIntro: A series is a list of videos to watch in order, for example a course in several episodes. The visitor gets a “Next” button.
seriesItemRemoved: Video removed from the series (it stays in the library).
seriesItemsHelp: The order below is the playing order. Videos that are not published are not shown to the public.
seriesItemsNone: This series is empty. Search for a video below to add it.
seriesItemsTitle: Videos in the series ({n} of {max} at most)
suggestReason: offers photo albums to link to your videos
tplAlready: You already have categories: nothing was added.
tplFieldHelp: No template is required: “Empty” creates nothing.
tplIntro: Pick a starting point in one click. You can rename, add or delete everything afterwards.
tplTitle: To start: a set of categories
welcomeText: Paste the address of a YouTube video (for example {example}). The title and thumbnail fill in by themselves. The video starts as a draft: you publish it when you want.
